find: Sanctions escalate depending on the substance involved, whether it was intentional, and whether the athlete has offended before. The typical sanctions ladder runs: formal warnings for minor first-time administrative breaches → fines → competition bans (ranging from one year to a lifetime ban) → criminal prosecution for those found trafficking banned substances. Results achieved during a doping period are typically annulled, meaning medals, records and prize money are returned.

Trafficking can also lead to criminal proceedings under national law.
